title: Aliens call humans water beings

tellings.quote: >> He always referred to us as water vessels or water beings, water humans.

plain: A being Dan Sherman says he was in contact with always called humans "water vessels or water beings, water humans." Sherman, a former Army sergeant, says the National Security Agency, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, and he describes this from his own time at a site he calls Base 2, between 1990 and 1993. If true, it would mean the beings saw people mainly as bodies made of water.
